verifiedClaims: RAAM takes no damage while covered by Kryll. Explosions or a dispatched swarm remove that cover.
Kryll avoid light; the source pre-fight supply room supports carrying four frag grenades.

implemented: Kryll shield blocks ordinary attacks, status effects, damage over time and external item/event damage.
A player-selected frag grenade disperses the shield on its delayed impact and uses one of four shared charges.
RAAM alternates his real Troika action and a single-target Kryll swarm action; sending that swarm exposes him until it returns.
Lit cover is a real formation position: heroes avoid swarm damage there; melee lunges out of that zone remain vulnerable.
Physical cover reduces Troika hits without granting blanket invulnerability.
Attack previews show zero damage while Kryll protect RAAM.
ATB, pause, manual targeting and dead actors constrain source encounter commands and freeze delayed impacts.
Automatic battle uses light cover and waits for real openings after ammunition is exhausted.
External direct damage keeps its precomputed fixed loss, optional pickup shield semantics and nonlethal floor after the source gate.
adaptations: The existing perspective ATB battlefield replaces the original third-person cover-shooter camera.
Four frag charges are shared by the crossover squad; the original carry limit is four per player.
A frag opening lasts 720 simulation ticks (12 seconds at 60 Hz), deliberately allowing a slow solo ATB hero to recharge and land a follow-up hit. This is not an asserted source timing.
Swarm travel/duration, periodic damage, damage values and a 0.55 Troika cover multiplier are project balancing values.
Selecting lit cover moves a hero to one authored illuminated lane and consumes full ATB. Source controls are not reproduced.
The crossover hero kits remain available; the original train weapon availability is not certified for those kits.
remaining: Original cover traversal, RAAM advancing between train cars, camera and active reload.
A source Torque Bow equipment/weapon selection and its explosive bolt interaction.
Original damage/animation timings and source-identical projectile/lighting art.
Existing character and backdrop bitmaps still require visual review; no bitmap is marked 1:1 by these mechanical changes.
preserved: Stage ID 1, hero/template IDs, rewards, max HP and stored stats.
Existing first-wave Locust combat and all other stages and custom battles.
Public historical generation ledger and all image files.
